title: Personal Time Capsule — privacy-overrides.yaml
description: Structural schema for a capsule's per-item privacy override list. See ../PRIVACY.md for the field-by-field explanation and rationale. Covers ROADMAP.md item 12 (privacy model) only.

path.description: Relative to the bag root, one of three forms: an exact file path ("data/email/2011-03-02-medical-bill.eml"), a directory prefix ending in "/" matching every file under it recursively ("data/email/2003/"), or a glob pattern containing "*"/"**"/"?" ("data/email/2003-*.eml", "data/photos/**/*.jpg"). See PRIVACY.md's "Path matching" section for exact semantics and precedence when more than one entry matches the same file.

privacy_zone.description: Overrides this item's privacy zone from whatever its collection (or the capsule-wide default) declares. Same vocabulary as capsule.schema.json's privacy_zone.

release_policy.description: Optional. Overrides this item's release policy independently of its privacy_zone override — e.g. a single item that should release later (or earlier) than the rest of its collection. Same shape as capsule.yaml's release_policy.

category.description: Optional, free text. Not a closed vocabulary — see PRIVACY.md's recommended starter list (financial, credentials, medical, government-id, third-party-privacy, other) and its rationale for staying open rather than enforced.

reason.description: Optional. Free-text explanation of why this item is overridden.

flagged_by.description: Optional. Free text: who or what identified the need for this override, e.g. "Jane Smith (creator)" or "ptc scan v0.1 (creator-confirmed)". Same convention as data/provenance/events.yaml's agent field.
